title: Persona 3 Reload GUI
description: Texture pack that changes the Minecraft's GUI to a P3R based GUI.
body:
# **Video preview**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6Ut-cSb2iBE" title="Reprodutor de vídeo do YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# **CurseForge Download**
[![CurseForge](https://i.postimg.cc/0yn5dkp4/image.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/persona-3-reload-gui)

# **Thanks for the 254 downloads!**
![254 Downloads](https://i.postimg.cc/90n2NbWv/image.png)

# **What is this mod?**
This is a Texture Pack that replaces the Minecraft's GUI by a Persona 3 Reload based GUI.

# **Future plans**
- Make custom textures for other mods
- Make a Persona 4 (currently in development btw) and Persona 5 version once I finish this pack.
- Add animated background once I finally learn how to do so.

# **P4R GUI Sneak Peek**
![P4R GUI Resource pack image](https://i.postimg.cc/KYcSZt30/image.png)
![P4R GUI Menu](https://i.postimg.cc/h4XH2Dq8/image.png)
![P4R GUI Hotbar](https://i.postimg.cc/XJCkyDTG/image.png)
![P4R GUI Inventory](https://i.postimg.cc/kX9vBsw6/image.png)

# **Compatibilities**
- Should be compatible with any mod or texture pack. (be sure to set the loading priority above any texture pack to be able to see it)
- Not tested with other Minecraft versions besides 1.20.1 and 26.2
